verifications.note: "Traversing Jack, Parker and Hood counties, the pipeline has a capacity of 450,000 Mcf/d, which can be expanded to 650,000 Mcf/d." (article is about the Worsham-Steed Pipeline by name throughout)
Operator (NorTex Midstream / Williams) facilities page, Tolar Hub section: "Worsham-Steed Pipeline Capacity: 450,000 Mcf/d" — names the pipeline directly and states the identical value

resolutions.researcher_notes: Recorded Capacity = 450000.00 Mcf/d, confirmed exactly (no rounding gap) by two independent sources naming this pipeline: (1) NaturalGasIntel's original in-service announcement, already cited on this row for other columns — states 'the pipeline has a capacity of 450,000 Mcf/d, which can be expanded to 650,000 Mcf/d' (450,000 Mcf/d is the base/nameplate capacity recorded on the sheet; the 650,000 Mcf/d figure is an expansion capacity, not in conflict); (2) the operator's own facilities page (nortexmidstream.com, a Williams/NorTex Midstream asset page, independent of the NGI wire story) which states under the Tolar Hub section: 'Worsham-Steed Pipeline Capacity: 450,000 Mcf/d'. Note the operator page separately gives Worsham-Steed GAS STORAGE facility MDIQ/MDWQ figures (450,000/500,000 Mcf/d) which are a different asset's injection/withdrawal rates, not the pipeline capacity — not used here to avoid conflating pipeline vs. storage-facility throughput.
